sloka: शुनःशेपम् नरश्रेष्ठ गृहीत्वा तु महायशाः ।व्यश्रामत् पुष्करे राजा मध्याह्ने रघुनंदन ॥१-६२-१॥
transliteration: śunaḥśepam naraśreṣṭha gṛhītvā tu mahāyaśāḥ ।vyaśrāmat puṣkare rājā madhyāhne raghunaṁdana ॥1-62-1॥

translations.english: O Foremost of men, O Delight of the Raghus (Rama) the illustrious king (Ambarisha) took Sunassepha with him. (On the way) at Pushkara he took some rest at noon.
